Empire of Static

Play

The city is wired for a storm. A district-wide blackout hands the street crews a week of borrowed power and the Static Saints a reason to collect it. You climb, drain, and decide who keeps the lights on.

Every power is a choice between a clean arc and a loud one. Chain bolts across rooftops, drag a streetcar off its line, or leave the whole block dark behind you.

Notes: remember to drain the substation before the second blackout.
